question: DREAM is related to IWJFR in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, FILED is related to KNQJI. To which of the given options is BLOWN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, DREAM is related to IWJFR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a9911fa7414b78a1cda83aad826a97974e561210e7ac68dfbe57b78aaaf09e4.png] 

For, FILED is related to KNQJI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15bcde9273ca3148c0c6e61a7af9ba443ef8d044097742667e250305fc82ffe5.png] 

Similarly, for **BLOWN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee0d993e3bb5f642a4caf5bb13fecf9c121346ce1357811b388a4ccccf307ef9.png] 

So, BLOWN will be related to **GQTBS**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
